title: Sunday Quick Tip
subtitle: When the score gets lopsided
hook: You are up by ten runs. What do you change?
intro: The other team's players have stopped trying.
statement: How you win teaches as much as winning does.
q1: Do you add rules like bunting only —
q2: or let your team play their normal game?
q3: What do you want both teams to remember?
t1: There is no single right way. But a game stays a game
t2: when both teams still have something to play for.
cta: Coaches — what do you do with a big lead?
ctaLines: Bunt only. Station to station. New positions.
ctaPrompt: Share your game habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
You are up by ten runs. What do you change?
Your team is hitting everything. The other team's players have stopped trying.
How you win teaches as much as winning does.
Add new rules or play your normal game. There is no perfect answer.
What do you do with a big lead? Share your habit in the comments.
